item.title: Kurds in Cyprus protest ongoing attacks against Kurdish people in Rojava
item.description: The Kurdish community in Cyprus staged a protest march in Nicosia over ongoing attacks against the Kurdish people in Syria’s Rojava region on Thursday, January 29, 2026.

item.title: Christodoulides submits five-point proposal for Cyprus talks as Holguín prioritises confidence measures
item.description: President Nikos Christodoulides submitted a five-point proposal to advance Cyprus negotiations at yesterday’s trilateral meeting, but UN envoy María Ángela Holguín showed no rush to move beyond confidence-building measures. item.title: January rainfall exceeds normal levels in most of Cyprus, reaching 117% of average
item.description: Average rainfall in Cyprus’s free areas exceeded normal January values, reaching 117% by January 29, the Department of Meteorology said. The average total rainfall from January 1 reached 119.8 millimetres. item.title: Parliament criminalises mobile phones in Central Prisons with penalties up to three years
item.description: The parliament approved the criminalisation of mobile phones in Central Prison with strict penalties.
